layout.body:
Dear Ms. Parker,
We want to acknowledge receipt of and thank you for your letter dated September 28th concerning issues of Sports Today not sent to you. We have investigated the matter and found that you should have received your September and October issues, as your subscription is not up for renewal until November 1, 2018.
We would hereby like to apologize sincerely for our mistakes. I have corrected the error and raised a packing order to be sent to you tomorrow on October 19, 2018, for the two missing issues. And to make up for the mistakes we have made, we have enclosed our two other best selling magazines(Cars Today and Home Today) in a different package.
We'd also like to let you know that we value you as an important customer to Sports Today. We have attached a self addressed, postage-paid envelope and a subscription form with a special discount of 25% off our normal rates for your convenience.
Once again, please accept our sincere apology for the inconvenience we caused you. Feel free to contact us or email us if you need any further help or clarification. We will always be at your service.
Tom Bridges
Customer Service Officer

questions.stem: What is Mr. Bridges’ main purpose in writing this letter?

options.A: To thank the customer for subscribing to their magazine
options.B: To make a complaint about some bad service
options.C: To renew the subscription for another year
options.D: To provide an answer to an inquiry the customer had made

questions.analysis: What is Mr. Bridges’ main purpose in writing this letter? 原文依据：We want to acknowledge receipt of and thank you for your letter dated September 28th concerning issues of Sports Today not sent to you. We have investigated the matter… 这封信是回复顾客之前的来信与投诉，说明未收到杂志的原因、道歉并给出解决方案。 A：感谢顾客订阅杂志 → 不是主要目的 B：投诉糟糕的服务 → 写信人是客服，不是来投诉的 C：再续订一年 → 文中只是提供续订优惠，不是目的 D：对顾客提出的问题进行答复 → 正确

questions.stem: When did Ms. Parker send the letter?
questions.analysis: When did Ms. Parker send the letter? 原文依据：your letter dated September 28th 信里明确写了顾客来信的日期是 September 28。 A：10 月 18 日 → 这是写回信的日期 B：9 月 28 日 → 正确 C：11 月 1 日 → 订阅到期日 D：10 月 19 日 → 补发杂志的日期

questions.stem: What will Ms. Parker receive as compensation?

options.A: A 25% discount on her next subscription
options.B: Other publications from the same company at no cost
options.C: A check for the missing magazines
options.D: An apology letter from the president of the company

questions.analysis: What will Ms. Parker receive as compensation? 原文依据：to make up for the mistakes we have made, we have enclosed our two other best selling magazines (Cars Today and Home Today) 作为补偿，她会收到同公司另外两本免费杂志。 A：下次订阅 25% 折扣 → 这是优惠，不是补偿 B：同公司的其他免费出版物 → 正确 C：支票 → 文中没有 D：总裁的道歉信 → 是客服写的信，不是总裁
